quest.title: Spike Self-Circulation Report: Conclusion
quest.description: The Spike is gradually sealing the Ley Line rupture up. Inform Hosseini of this result.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: How did it go? Did you manage to operate the Spike successfully?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Good, good. Though the Pursina's Spike cannot seal the opening in one go, as long as it is successful once, continued operation should not be an issue.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: This means that it's really just a matter of time before the opening closes completely.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: I must record this... For all I know, I may yet become a figure of some influence in the Akademiya once the full research report on the Pursina's Spikes is submitted.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: #I might even write it into my future memoirs. I can see it now: "My Experiments With the Preternaturally Skilled {NICKNAME} at The Chasm..."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll be waiting eagerly for that day to come.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Haha! Well, I fear I'm not hardly as good at writing stories as I am at reports.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: I can only hope that you'll forgive any flaws in my work.

choices.text: Most of the dark mud is gone.
